title: Nest Mart Grocery Store
label: Featured Project
description: A live grocery storefront with clean browsing, polished product presentation and a responsive shopping interface.

details.overview: Nest Mart is a fully responsive grocery store frontend built with React. The goal was to create a modern, clean shopping experience that feels professional and easy to navigate — similar to real e-commerce platforms.
challenges: Building a dynamic product listing system with React components
Making the layout fully responsive across all screen sizes
Deploying and configuring the app on Vercel with proper routing
learnings: Deepened understanding of React component architecture
Learned how to manage state for cart and product filtering
Gained experience with Vercel deployment and environment setup
features: Responsive grid layout for all devices
Clean modern UI inspired by real grocery platforms

title: Swizza's World
label: Creative Project
description: A personal poetry platform presenting original poems across themes of nature, love and hope with a minimal reading experience.

details.overview: Swizza's World is a personal poetry website built to give original poems a beautiful home on the web. The design focuses on a calm, atmospheric reading experience with minimal distractions — letting the words speak for themselves.
challenges: Designing a layout that feels emotional and atmospheric without being heavy
Building a multi-page site with smooth navigation using vanilla JS
Keeping the UI minimal while still feeling polished and intentional
learnings: Improved CSS layout and typography skills for content-focused design
Learned how to create mood through colour, spacing and font choices
Practiced building multi-page sites without any framework
features: Multi-page structure — Home, Poems, About, Contact
Original poetry collection with category tags
Minimal atmospheric design focused on reading

title: Smart Quiz App
label: Frontend Project
description: An interactive quiz app with smooth question flow and a clean, lightweight interface.

details.overview: Smart Quiz App is an interactive browser-based quiz application built with vanilla JavaScript. It focuses on a smooth, engaging user experience with clear question progression and instant feedback.
challenges: Managing quiz state and question progression with pure JavaScript
Handling score tracking and result display logic
Keeping the UI clean and distraction-free during the quiz flow
learnings: Strengthened vanilla JavaScript DOM manipulation skills
Learned how to structure interactive UI logic without a framework
Practiced building user flows with clear start, progress and end states

title: Text to Speech Converter
label: Web Project
description: A browser-based speech synthesizer exploring voice interaction through a simple, accessible interface.

details.overview: Text to Speech Converter is a browser-based tool that uses the Web Speech API to convert typed text into spoken audio. It explores how native browser APIs can be used to build accessible, voice-driven web experiences.
challenges: Understanding and implementing the Web Speech API correctly
Handling browser compatibility differences for speech synthesis
Building a clean UI that makes the tool intuitive to use
learnings: Learned how to work with native browser Web APIs
Understood the basics of accessibility and voice interaction on the web
Practiced building simple, focused single-purpose tools
features: Uses native Web Speech API — no external libraries
